gaps.description: Form fields are specified only for annual leave; the other six request types have no field definitions.
Annual leave quota 'varies by seniority' with no stated formula or tiers.
Carried-over leave from the previous year is mentioned for manual HR adjustment but no expiry or cap rule is given.
Half-day leave is supported but the RFP does not state how it is counted against the quota (0.5 day assumed).
Login with the company email account is required but the identity provider and whether SSO is phase-1 scope are unspecified.
Notification via 'company chat tools' is desired without naming the tool or confirming it is in scope.
Approval delegation is flagged nice to have; phase-1 inclusion undecided.
No rule for in-flight requests when an employee transfers department or leaves the company.
Attendance-device integration is out of scope for phase 1 but must be anticipated; no interface contract is defined.
'Periodic backup' is required without RPO/RTO, retention period or backup frequency.
Existing paper and Excel request history exists; migration is neither requested nor excluded.
The UI must be Vietnamese while the project documentation language is configured as English; localisation requirements for the product are otherwise unstated.
